'''Ralph McQuarrie''' (13 June 1929 – 3 March 2012) was an American concept artist. His career included work on the original ''Star Wars'' trilogy.<ref name="wp-rm">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ralph_McQuarrie Ralph McQuarrie], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026024914/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ralph_McQuarrie Internet Archive], 26 October 2026.</ref>

The [[Special Edition]] card [[General McQuarrie]] is [[Decipher]]'s nod to him, and the picture on the card is of McQuarrie.<ref name="ins74-51">"Hoth Freezes Over: Who's Who in Echo Base", ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' #74 (2004), p. 51. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/star-wars-insider-d0e5c1/page/n46/mode/1up Internet Archive].</ref> The character was not seen in the film.<ref name="ins74-51" />
